title: Additional Cast for 'Odoru Sennen Kazoku' Announced
content:
The official website for the television anime adaptation of Akira Kazugai 's Odoru Sennen Kazoku ( Millennium Family ) manga announced six additional cast members on Sunday. The anime series will air on TBS and other channels.

Cast Arthur: Mutsumi Tamura ( Kobayashi-san Chi no Maid Dragon ) Raine: Haruna Mikawa ( Ore dake Level Up na Ken ) Noel: Taihi Kimura ( Onmyou Kaiten Re:Birth ) Eve: Lynn ( Bokutachi wa Benkyou ga Dekinai ) Hayden: Katsuyuki Konishi ( Kimetsu no Yaiba ) Hugo: Ryouta Suzuki ( Kaguya-sama wa Kokurasetai )

• Masato Jinbo ( Tate no Yuusha no Nariagari Season 2 , Dokyuu Hentai HxEros ) is directing the anime at PartsCraft and is also in charge of series composition. Hiroshi Yoneda ( Nozomanu Fushi no Boukensha animation director) is designing the characters and serving as chief animation director.

Kazugai began serializing the action comedy manga in Young King OURs magazine in March 2021. Shounen Gahousha published the ninth volume on July 30.

Orange Inc. licensed the manga in English and published it digitally through the emaqi app.

title: Mistress Kanan Is Devilishly Easy Season 2 Anime Reveals Visual, Trailer, Additional Cast
content:
The previously announced Mistress Kanan Is Devilishly Easy Season 2, now titled Mistress Kanan is Devilishly Easy 2 EASY revealed a new visual, trailer, and four additional voice cast. The sequel is set to premiere in 2027.

The additional cast includes:

• Misato Matsuoka as Tekka Shinryuji

• Miku Ito as Hanako Ohanabatake

• Miyu Tomita as Lily Kageno

• Lynn as Koko Kyougi

Studio KAI returns to animate the second season with Yasushi Muroya as director. Other returning staff includes Hisashi Isogawa as assistant director, Rintaro Ikeda as the scriptwriter, and Akari Minagawa as the character designer. The cast will also reprise their roles:

• Aoi Koga as Kanan Takakiyo

• Seiichiro Yamashita as Yoji Kyogi

• Sayumi Suzushiro as Jeanne

• Maki Kawase as Ami

• Ayaka Nanase as Nadeko

• Fuka Izumi as Milch

• Hikaru Tono as Miel

• Yoshino Nanjo as Lilim

The anime is based on a manga titled Kanan-sama wa Akumade Choroi , written and drawn by Nonco. It has been serialized in Kodansha’s Weekly Shonen Magazine since June 2022. The official synopsis is described: Kanan, a female demon who preys on human souls, goes undercover at a human high school. She sets her sights on one particular male student—but somehow ends up in a relationship contract with him!? Having never experienced love before, Kanan is overwhelmed by unfamiliar emotions…! A whirlwind of sweet-and-sour youth and nonstop gags!! Get ready for the pure-hearted demon girl’s adorably clumsy first love rom-com to begin !

title: Mistress Kanan is Devilishly Easy Season 2's 1st Video Unveils More Cast & Staff, 2027 Debut
content:
The official website for the television anime of nonco 's Mistress Kanan is Devilishly Easy ( Kanan-sama wa Akumade Choroi ) manga revealed the first full promotional video, teaser visual, more cast and staff members, 2027 premiere, and the title Kanan-sama wa Akumade Choroi 2 EASY ( Mistress Kanan is Devilishly Easy 2 EASY ) for the second anime season on Tuesday.

The newly announced cast members are:

Misato Matsuoka as Tekka Shinryūji

Miku Itō as Hanako Ohanabatake

Miyu Tomita as Lily Kageno

Lynn as Koko Kyōgi

Returning cast members include:

• Aoi Koga as Kanan Takakiyo

• Seiichirō Yamashita as Yōji Kyōgi

• Sayumi Suzushiro as Jeanne

• Maki Kawase as Ami

• Ayaka Nanase as Nadeko Masurao

• Fūka Izumi as Milch Zebul

• Hikaru Tōno as Miel Zebul

• Yoshino Nanjō as Lilim Zebul

• Takaya Kuroda as Beelzebub

• Yui Ogura as Yuriko Yurino

• Ayana Taketatsu as Yui Rorikawa

• Yū Kobayashi as Ryoko Reizen

Yasushi Muroya ( BASTARD!! -Heavy Metal, Dark Fantasy- , BLUELOCK , Fairy Tail episode director) returns to direct the second anime season at Studio KAI with Hisashi Isogawa also returning as assistant director. Rintarō Ikeda ( Detectives These Days Are Crazy! , Insomniacs After School ) is again in charge of the series scripts, and Akari Minagawa ( Shabake , The Perfect Prince Loves Me, the Side Character?! ) is again designing the characters.

Additional new and returning staff members are:

• Sub-Character Design: Chisa Shibata

• Prop Design: Nana Koinuma

• Art Director: Takimi Echizen (new)

• Art Setting: Studio Uni, Quun Plant

• Color Key Artist: Mineyo Ōnishi

• 3D CG Director: Masanari Kira

• Compositing Director of Photography: Shigeki Asakawa

• Editing: Masato Yoshitake

• Sound Director: Yasushi Nagura

• Sound Effects: Rio Satō

• Music: Shūhei Mutsuki

• Music Production: King Records

• Chief Animation Producer: Hirokazu Shiba (first season animation producer)

• Animation Producer: Ippei Takenaka (new)

The manga centers on Kanan, a demoness who has infiltrated human society as a high schooler to partake of delicions souls. She has here eyes set on one particular high school boy, but before she even gets a chance to do anything about it, she has already become his girlfriend. For Kanan, who has never been in love before, the relationship is filled with nothing but new experiences.

The anime's first season premiered on April 4 on Tokyo MX and BS11 at 25:00 JST (effectively, April 5 at 1:00 a.m. JST). Crunchyroll is streaming the anime with an English dub .

The manga launched in Kodansha 's Weekly Shōnen Magazine in June 2022. Kodansha will publish the manga's 15th compiled book volume on December 16.

Seven Seas Entertainment began releasing the manga in English in omnibus format in July.

title: Witch Watch Manga Ends With Anime Season 2 to Air in 2027
content:
Kenta Shinohara 's Witch Watch manga ended in this year's 51st issue of Shueisha 's Weekly Shonen Jump magazine on Monday. The staff of the television anime adaptation also unveiled its second season's teaser visual and 2027 premiere window.

Viz Media and MANGA Plus are both publishing Witch Watch in English. Viz Media describes the first volume:

Morihito Otogi's family is descended from a long line of ogre familiars, and he has the inhuman strength to prove it. One day, his father comes to him with the life-changing news that he is to become the familiar of his childhood friend, the teenage witch Nico. He is to live under the same roof with her and protect her from anything and anyone that may attempt to harm her. Meanwhile, Nico is excited to get to live with the love of her life, even if her crush is one-sided—Morihito is so serious about his duties to protect her that any romance is going to be an uphill battle. But he has every reason to be serious, as Nico has a prophecy of doom hanging over her head!

The anime's English dub debuted on April 27, 2025. The anime also has dubs in French, German, Italian, Portuguese (Brazil), Spanish (Spain and Latin), and Thai.

GKIDS screened the first three episodes of the anime in North American theaters on March 16-18, 2025. Tropics screened the episodes in Asia starting on March 18, ADN screened the episodes in "selected European countries" in March, and Aniplus screened the episodes in South Korea on March 21.

Shinohara ( Astra Lost in Space , Sket Dance ) launched the manga in Shueisha 's Weekly Shonen Jump magazine in February 2021. Shueisha published the manga's 23rd compiled book volume on September 4.

title: 'Kanan-sama wa Akumade Choroi 2nd Season' Reveals Additional Cast, New Staff, First Promo, 2027 Debut
content:
The official website for the television anime adaptation of nonco 's Kanan-sama wa Akumade Choroi ( Mistress Kanan is Devilishly Easy ) manga revealed additional cast, new staff, a teaser visual (pictured), and the first promotional video for the second season , subtitled Easy , on Tuesday. The anime series will premiere in 2027.

Cast Tekka Shinryuuji: Misato Matsuoka ( Yani Neko ) Hanako Ohanabatake: Miku Itou ( 5-toubun no Hanayome ) Lily Kageno: Miyu Tomita ( Kaguya-sama wa Kokurasetai? Tensai-tachi no Renai Zunousen ) Koko Kyougi: Lynn ( Kimi no Suizou wo Tabetai )

Takimi Echizen ( Henjin no Salad Bowl ) replaces Nobuaki Mihara as art director. Hirokazu Shiba ( Kanan-sama wa Akumade Choroi animation producer) serves as chief animation producer, while Ippei Takenaka joins as animation producer.

Produced by Studio Kai , the first season aired in 12 episodes in Spring 2026. Crunchyroll streamed the anime in multiple subtitles and dubs in English, German, and Thai.

Yasushi Muroya ( Tejina-senpai ) returns to direct the second season at Studio KAI, with Hisashi Isogawa ( Eromanga-sensei key animation) serving as assistant director. Other returning staff include series composer Rintarou Ikeda ( Kimi wa Houkago Insomnia ), character designer Akari Minagawa ( Shabake ), and music composer Shuuhei Mutsuki ( Yarinaoshi Reijou wa Ryuutei Heika wo Kouryakuchuu ).

nonco began serializing the manga in Weekly Shounen Magazine in June 2022. Kodansha published the 14th volume on August 17.

Seven Seas Entertainment licensed the manga in English for 2-in-1 omnibus release in October 2025 and released the first two volumes on July 14. The third and fourth volumes are scheduled for a November 24 release.

title: Josemaru Short Anime's 3rd Teaser Reveals More Cast, January 10 Debut
content:
The staff for the television short anime of creator Inochi-ya's Josemaru character revealed on Tuesday the anime's third teaser promotional video, key visual, three additional cast members, and January 10 premiere. In the video, the title character J osemaru introduces the cast of characters.

The newly announced cast members are:

Mariya Ise as Latte, a toy poodle

Hikaru Tōno as Ichigo Milk (literally, "Strawberry Milk"), a poodle

Nana Enomoto as Goma Milk (literally, "Sesame Milk"), a American Cocker Spaniel

Riho Tsuda voices the title character Josemaru.

Creator Inochi-ya is also directing the anime. Animi is credited for planning production.

Additional staff members include:

• Planning: Yūya Ogawa, Hitoshi Ono (TV Asahi)

• Character Design: Mai Narushima

• Sound Effects: Yuika Shiraishi

• Promotional Design: Hirotoshi Ikewaki

• Stop-Motion Animation: Rikuto Konagaya (dwarf studios), Hiroki Itō (dwarf studios)

• Series Scripts/Production Producer: Risa Satosaki

• Music/Animation Production: Flow Entertainment

• Executive Producer: Yukiko Shirakura (TV Asahi)

• Producer: Yūki Tsudo (TV Asahi)

The anime will premiere on January 10 on " PicoAni , " TV Asahi 's new short anime programming, and will air every Sunday at 10:00 a.m. JST (Kanto local).

title: Sonic the Hedgehog, McLaren Racing Collaborates on 3-Episode Animated Special
content:
The official X (formerly Twitter ) of the Sonic the Hedgehog franchise started streaming a teaser trailer for a new three-episode animated special titled Sonic the Hedgehog x McLaren Racing: Beyond Fast , on Monday.

The Sonic Racing: CrossWorlds game also announced that it will add "Sonic (McLaren Racing)" as the second free update for Year Two on Tuesday.

McLaren Racing announced in 2025 a multi-year partnership with Sonic the Hedgehog franchise , making Sega the official gaming partner of McLaren Racing.

Sega began streaming the full Sonic the Hedgehog: Memories and Beyond 35th anniversary short film on Friday.

An animation project for the Sonic Racing CrossWorlds game debuted in August 2025.

Netflix and Sega are producing a new children's animated series for the Sonic the Hedgehog franchise . The new show is targeted towards upper preschoolers.

The Sonic Prime animated series debuted on Netflix in December 2022 with one 40-minute episode and seven 20-minute episodes. Netflix streamed the third season in January 2024.

The live-action Sonic the Hedgehog 4 film is scheduled for a March 19, 2027 release. The franchise is also receiving a fifth film in 2028.

title: The Eternal Fool's Words of Wisdom: A Pawsitively Fantastic Adventure Anime Unveils Main Trailer, January 9 Premiere, Additional Cast, Theme Songs
content:
The Eternal Fool’s Words of Wisdom: A Pawsitively Fantastic Adventure anime TV anime unveiled a main trailer and is officially set to begin broadcasting on January 9, 2027, on TOKYO MX, BS Asahi, AT-X and other channels. Crunchyroll will stream the series and the simulcast schedule will be announced on a later date.

Rie Kugimiya also joins the cast as the voice of Aileen. A new character visual and an official comment from Kugimiya have also been released:

“I’m Rie Kugimiya, and I’ll be voicing Aileen. She may look cute and delicate, but she’s actually quite a bit older than she appears and is an incredibly strong character in more ways than one! I’m putting everything I’ve got into the role so I can match her powerful personality. The series is full of fun interactions between its many characters, and I hope you’ll look forward to watching it!”

Additionally, the opening and ending theme songs for the TV anime have been revealed. The opening theme song is “321 Smiling” by Nako Misaki × sajou no hana, while the ending theme song is “Mirai no Vision” by ARCANA PROJECT. Comments from the artists have also been released.

Nako Misako’s comment:

“Hello, I’m Nako Misaki, and I’m delighted to be performing the theme song for the TV anime “The Eternal Fool’s Words of Wisdom: A Pawsitively Fantastic Adventure.” I had the pleasure of singing “321 Smiling” together with sana from sajou no hana. Just like Asley and Pochi, I felt as though I was setting off on an adventure with a trusted partner by my side as I sang alongside sana. I hope the song’s energy, like a refreshing wind pushing you forward, and the excitement of setting out on an adventure will reach everyone who listens. I’m really looking forward to watching the anime myself!”

Comment from sajou no hana:

“After reading the original story, I was really touched by the relationship between Asley and Pochi. They’re always by each other’s side as if it’s the most natural thing in the world. They may argue from time to time, but whenever one of them is in trouble, the other is always there to help. We wanted to capture the feelings that come from their unique bond and the charm of their partnership through upbeat music and lyrics. We hope everyone watching the anime will start each episode with a big smile as soon as they hear the countdown, ‘3, 2, 1!'”

Comment from ARCANA PROJECT:

“We’re truly honored to be performing the ending theme song for the TV anime “The Eternal Fool’s Words of Wisdom: A Pawsitively Fantastic Adventure”! Even when things don’t go as planned, ordinary days can turn into special adventures when you’re with someone important to you. That’s the positive feeling we wanted to express in “Mirai no Vision,” a song filled with an upbeat and cheerful sound. We hope it makes everyone who listens feel a little more excited about the day ahead. Please enjoy the song along with Asley and Pochi’s journey!”

Synopsis: After accidentally creating a miraculous potion known as the “Eternity Elixir,” Asley gains a body that never ages. With seemingly endless time on his hands, he spends the next 5,000 years studying and mastering countless Spells and Hexes, eventually becoming an exceptionally powerful Sorcerer capable of wielding long-lost ancient Hexes. Hoping to broaden his horizons, Asley sets out on a journey with his familiar and longtime companion, Pochi. But when he stops to help someone along the way, his life takes an unexpected turn. Now, a 5,000-year-old young man and an 800-year-old dog are about to embark on a new adventure. Overpowered yet a little out of touch, Asley finds himself caught up in a lively coming-of-age fantasy unlike any other! Rie Kugimiya also joins the cast as the voice of Aileen. A new character visual and an official comment from Kugimiya have also been released:

“I’m Rie Kugimiya, and I’ll be voicing Aileen. She may look cute and delicate, but she’s actually quite a bit older than she appears and is an incredibly strong character in more ways than one! I’m putting everything I’ve got into the role so I can match her powerful personality. The series is full of fun interactions between its many characters, and I hope you’ll look forward to watching it!”

Additionally, the opening and ending theme songs for the TV anime have been revealed. The opening theme song is “321 Smiling” by Nako Misaki × sajou no hana, while the ending theme song is “Mirai no Vision” by ARCANA PROJECT. Comments from the artists have also been released.
Nako Misako’s comment:

“Hello, I’m Nako Misaki, and I’m delighted to be performing the theme song for the TV anime “The Eternal Fool’s Words of Wisdom: A Pawsitively Fantastic Adventure.” I had the pleasure of singing “321 Smiling” together with sana from sajou no hana. Just like Asley and Pochi, I felt as though I was setting off on an adventure with a trusted partner by my side as I sang alongside sana. I hope the song’s energy, like a refreshing wind pushing you forward, and the excitement of setting out on an adventure will reach everyone who listens. I’m really looking forward to watching the anime myself!”
Comment from sajou no hana:

“After reading the original story, I was really touched by the relationship between Asley and Pochi. They’re always by each other’s side as if it’s the most natural thing in the world. They may argue from time to time, but whenever one of them is in trouble, the other is always there to help. We wanted to capture the feelings that come from their unique bond and the charm of their partnership through upbeat music and lyrics. We hope everyone watching the anime will start each episode with a big smile as soon as they hear the countdown, ‘3, 2, 1!'”
Comment from ARCANA PROJECT:

“We’re truly honored to be performing the ending theme song for the TV anime “The Eternal Fool’s Words of Wisdom: A Pawsitively Fantastic Adventure”! Even when things don’t go as planned, ordinary days can turn into special adventures when you’re with someone important to you. That’s the positive feeling we wanted to express in “Mirai no Vision,” a song filled with an upbeat and cheerful sound. We hope it makes everyone who listens feel a little more excited about the day ahead. Please enjoy the song along with Asley and Pochi’s journey!”

Synopsis: After accidentally creating a miraculous potion known as the “Eternity Elixir,” Asley gains a body that never ages. With seemingly endless time on his hands, he spends the next 5,000 years studying and mastering countless Spells and Hexes, eventually becoming an exceptionally powerful Sorcerer capable of wielding long-lost ancient Hexes. Hoping to broaden his horizons, Asley sets out on a journey with his familiar and longtime companion, Pochi. But when he stops to help someone along the way, his life takes an unexpected turn. Now, a 5,000-year-old young man and an 800-year-old dog are about to embark on a new adventure. Overpowered yet a little out of touch, Asley finds himself caught up in a lively coming-of-age fantasy unlike any other! title: The Eternal Fool's Words of Wisdom Anime's New Video Unveils More Cast, Theme Songs, January 9 Debut
content:
The staff for the television anime of Hifumi's The Eternal Fool's Words of Wisdom ( Yūkyū no Gusha Asley no, Kenja no Susume ) novels streamed the main promotional video for the anime on Tuesday. The video announces another cast member and the January 9 premiere date for the anime. It also announces and previews the anime's opening theme song "321 smiling" by Nako Misaki × sajou no hana , and the ending theme song "Mirai no Vision" (Future Vision) by ARCANA PROJECT .

The anime will debut on the Tokyo MX channel on January 9 at 10:00 p.m. (8:00 a.m. EST), on BS Asahi on January 10, and on AT-X on January 12.

Rie Kugimiya joins the cast as Aileen, one of the six leading mages in the world.

J-Novel Club is releasing the novels' manga adaptation under the title The Eternal Fool's Words of Wisdom: A Pawsitively Fantastic Adventure , and it describes the story:

A couple thousand years of solitude would wear down any young man—that is, anyone except Asley, an eternally youthful and eternally foolish sorcerer. After all, he has man's best friend...er, familiar, to keep him company. When his Level 100 canine companion Pochi demands that he get some fresh air for the first time in two centuries, Asley sets out to reintegrate into society and test his magic mettle. His mission? Dropping several unglamorous titles from his repertoire and restoring his good (okay, decent) name. A brand-new world and fresh adventures await Asley after his many years of hermitage. Perhaps he'll lend Pochi a hand to place first in the mysterious Familiar Feud. Or maybe he'll lose all vestiges of dignity and turn tail. Whichever comes first! No matter what, Asley has great evil to fight, a big world to save, and even a little growing up to do...that is, if he can endure Pochi's “friendly advice” along the way!

Toshiyuki Toyonaga will star in the anime as Asley, and Yōko Hikasa will voice Pochi. Minori Fujidera plays Rina.

Keisuke Ōnishi ( The Healer Who Was Banished From His Party, Is, in Fact, the Strongest ) is directing the series at Studio Elle . Kurasumi Sunayama ( Dr. Stone: Science Future , Harem in the Labyrinth of Another World ) is in charge of the series scripts, and Yumiko Mizuno ( The Healer Who Was Banished From His Party, Is, in Fact, the Strongest ) will design the characters. Yuri Habuka ( Maebashi Witches , Sushi and Beyond ) is composing the music at Lantis .

Other staff members include:

• Art design, Art Director: Kaya Aoki

• Color Key Artist: Yūsuke Watanabe

• Compositing Director of Photography: Yūsaku Murakami

• Sound Director: Yukio Nagasaki

• Sound Effects: Hiromune Kurahashi

• Sound Production: Procen Studio

• Animation Producer: Suguru Shakagōri

Hifumi began serializing the original story on the Shōsetsuka ni Narō website in January 2015, and ended it in September 2019. Taibundo Publishing released the first print volume in September 2015, with illustrations by Kurihito Mutō , and released the 14th and final volume in December 2019.

Fuh Araki launched the manga adaptation on Earth Star Entertainment 's Comic Earth Star website in April 2017. Earth Star Entertainment shipped the 13th compiled book volume for the manga on February 12. J-Novel Club released the manga's 10th volume in English on September 9. The manga is also available on the Crunchyroll Manga app.
author: ANN

title: Live-Action Twisted Sisters Series Reveals More Cast, January 10 Debut
content:
NHK announced eight more cast members and the January 10 premiere date for the live-action series for Kazumi Yamashita 's Twisted Sisters manga on Tuesday. The new cast members include:

Hiroshi Tachi as Tadashi Ioroi, the father of Tiara, Junko, Rikako, and Ryōko

Jin Shirasu as Raizō Kameishi, the architect of the house where the sisters live

Rui Kurihara as Kotarō Ioroi, Junko's son

Haruki Mochizuki as Ren Yamoto, Tiara's boyfriend

Tomu Miyazaki as Ryūtoku Daimonji, a lawyer and executor of Tadashi's will

Fujiko Kojima as Yuki Yoneyama, an architect under Raizō, and a key person in the second half of the story

Yoshiyuki Tsubokura as Shingo Sakakibara, the editor of the shōjo magazine Frill , where Rikako's manga serializes

Nichika Akutsu as Ken Hosokawa, Rikako's editor for her manga

The series will premiere on the BS and BSP4K channel on January 10.

The series follows manga artist Rikako, who reunites with her estranged sisters over their dying father's will. The will demands the five sisters live together in a mansion and she discovers a secret sister she's never met.

The cast includes (pictured right, from left to right):

• Yumia Fujisaki as Tiara Ioroi

• Hikari Ishida as Junko Ioroi

• Miori Takimoto as Rikako Ioroi

• Hisako Manda as Ryōko Ioroi

Masao Iketani and Tomomi Maruyama will co-write the screenplay. Takashi Ninomiya will direct the series.

Yamashita launched the manga in Kodansha 's Morning magazine in June 2021. Kodansha shipped the ninth compiled book volume on January 22. The 10th volume will ship on Thursday.

Yamashita launched the Land manga on Kodansha 's Morning magazine March 2014, and ended it in July 2020. Kodansha shipped the 11th and final volume in September 2020. Yen Press publishes the series in English.

Yen Press is also publishing Yamashita's Wonder Boy manga in English.
